text:
emma_support: FYI customer reported sudden 403s on SSO after they rotated IdP certs ~15m ago. They say login worked right before rotation and then started failing across all users. Posting their error and what we see.

emma_support: error from customer's logs -> "SAMLResponse rejected: recipient mismatch "https://sp.customer.com/saml/acs?app=redwood" expected "https://sp.customer.com/saml/acs""

emma_support: our edge logs show 403s with VerifyAssertion failure: 
```
[2026-03-16T22:44:21Z] auth.saml VerifyAssertion failed: RecipientCheckFailed: recipient mismatch: got https://sp.customer.com/saml/acs?app=redwood expected https://sp.customer.com/saml/acs
[2026-03-16T22:44:21Z] auth.saml SignatureVerify: signature algorithm ECDSA-SHA256, cert thumbprint mismatch
```

emma_support: steps customer ran to repro: 1) IdP pushed new metadata to their IdP host 2) we pulled metadata via our metadata refresher 3) first login attempt -> 403. They provided metadata URL: https://idp.customer.com/metadata.xml and SP-entityID = https://sp.customer.com/  ACS URL = https://sp.customer.com/saml/acs?app=redwood

ryan_sre: @emma_support thanks. two quick checks : are we normalizing the ACS (strip query) when comparing recipient? we usually allow exact-match or SP-declared recipient. Also need the metadata fetch logs from our side (idp-fetcher).

idp-bot: metadata-refresh service: failed to apply new metadata for idp.customer.com at 2026-03-16T22:41:10Z -> certificate thumbprint changed. previous_thumbprint=AB:12:CD:34 new_thumbprint=EF:56:78:90

li_devops: @ryan_sre I pulled the fetcher logs: we did download the new metadata and saved; however our stored SP entry still has acs= https://sp.customer.com/saml/acs (no query). Looks like the SP told IdP to include a query param on their side, so IdP is sending Recipient=with-query. Our recipient-check step currently compares against the SP entry without query. should we consider normalizing?

henrik_engineer: Two distinct issues likely: (1) cert rotation changed key type (IdP switched from RSA to ECDSA) -> our verifier requires the cert publicKey type to match allowed algs for that partner, (2) recipient mismatch because our store strips querystring for backwards compatibility. If the SP expects query params as part of ACS, we need to treat it as a valid recipient.

maria_cse: Customer says they intentionally added ?app=redwood for multi-tenant routing. They did NOT change SP entityID. They also attached the new metadata excerpt. I pasted the <AssertionConsumerService Location=...> lines: 
```
<AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://sp.customer.com/saml/acs?app=redwood" index="0"/>
```

ryan_sre: ok that confirms the IdP is now asserting recipient with query. Two paths: quick fix = add the full ACS with query into our SP config so recipient check passes OR change recipient-check to accept exact match OR add a normalization config flag per-customer. For cert: run openssl to check thumbprint they provided vs what we fetched.

ryan_sre: Suggested commands to triage (run on infra box):
```
# fetch metadata and inspect cert
curl -sS https://idp.customer.com/metadata.xml -o /tmp/metadata.xml
xmllint --xpath 'string(//ds:X509Certificate)' /tmp/metadata.xml | sed -e 's/\n//g' > /tmp/idp-cert.b64
base64 -d /tmp/idp-cert.b64 > /tmp/idp-cert.der
openssl x509 -inform der -in /tmp/idp-cert.der -noout -fingerprint -sha256
```

ryan_sre: also check our SP record: `cat /etc/redwood/saml/sp-records/sp.customer.com.json` (look for acs URLs array).

li_devops: ran openssl check, thumbprint matches the new_thumbprint from idp-bot. Public key algorithm is secp256r1 (ECDSA). Our verifier config allowed: RSA with SHA256 + RSASSA-PSS. So signature verification fails.

henrik_engineer: We should add ECDSA support for partner-specific verifier quickly. I'll push a small verifier patch to accept ECDSA-SHA256 for this partner only. Meanwhile, easiest customer-facing fix: add the full ACS including ?app=redwood to our SP config so recipient check passes and ask them to temporarily re-add previous cert OR keep new cert and we accept ECDSA.

emma_support: Customer asked if there's a safe rollback on their side - they still have previous key and can re-publish old metadata. Do we want them to revert while we patch? Risk is window of downtime.

ryan_sre: yes, if they can revert to the previous metadata (previous cert) that's fastest to restore logins. But we should still deploy verifier update next 2-4 hours. I'll prepare a rollback playbook: update SP acs list to include query variant + temp allow ECDSA for this partner. Steps: 1) add ACS URL with query 2) run `systemctl restart redwood-saml-proxy` 3) verify with test user.

henrik_engineer: patch PR: `saml/verifier: allow ECDSA-SHA256 for partner idp.customer.com (opt-in)` -> staging already passing. Need production patch review + canary.

li_devops: I can add the SP acs entry now. Doing it during low traffic window. ETA 18 minutes.

maria_cse: I've told the customer to stand by and that we're applying a config change and may ask them to temporarily re-publish old metadata if we can't finish patch in 2 hours. They prefer we not ask them to revert unless necessary.

idp-bot: deploybot: canary deploy started for verifier patch at 2026-03-16T23:12:05Z -> 10% hosts

emma_support: thanks team. please post back quick test results. I'll keep customer updated. :thumbsup:

ryan_sre: update: added ACS with query to SP record, restarted proxy, performed test login with test-user@test.customer -> success (SAML Response accepted). Now monitoring.

li_devops: confirm: logs show no more RecipientCheckFailed entries for that SP after 23:20Z. Signature errors still appear on a few nodes until canary completes.

henrik_engineer: once canary reaches 100% we'll close the incident and follow up with a short postmortem recommending: 1) support query params in ACS matching, 2) doc for customers to mention ACS variations during cert rotations, 3) verifier alg compatibility matrix in onboarding.

emma_support: closing loop with customer now. Thanks all.

emma_support: action items: li_devops add acs (done), ryan_sre finish verifier rollout, henrik_engineer write postmortem draft.
